**sdd/issue-612-scalar-trailing-space/proposal**

# Proposal: `scalar()` must not read a trailing space as a value (#612)

## Intent

`scalar()` (`brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs:57`) uses `^${key}:[ \t]*(.+)$`. `[ \t]*` backtracks, so on `findings: ` the capture is the space itself: the match succeeds, `.trim()` yields `''`, and `scalar` answers non-`null`. In `parseEntryList` that routes the key into the INLINE branch and the block branch never runs — two readable findings become `malformed: ["findings"]`.

## Decisions (the three #477 deferred)

**D1 — repair `(.+)` -> `(\S.*)`, not trim-to-null.**
`scalar`'s contract is already written, in `parse-verdict.mjs:73-77`: it answers `null` for BOTH a missing key and a key whose value it could not capture; callers needing the distinction probe the key line separately (`SEQUENCING_KEY_RE`, `CONTROLS_KEY_RE`, `CONTROLS_NOT_APPLIED_KEY_RE`). So `key:` + whitespace must answer `null` — "no value" — not a third sentinel. Both candidates do that; they diverge on a value led by exotic whitespace (`key: <NBSP>v`): `(\S.*)` answers `null`, `(.*)`+trim answers `v`. Choose `(\S.*)` because its failure direction is REFUSAL, which is the safe direction on the governance path (D4). In-tree precedent: `governance-checks.test.mjs:42`, `^    name: (\S+)\s*$`.

**D2 — brain's emitters do not produce one, and that does not downgrade this.**
`renderDecision`, `renderVerdict` (`verdict.mjs:247`), `renderCheckpointClaim` all build `` `key: ${value}` ``: a trailing space needs a field stringifying to `''`, which no caller passes. So it only bites FOREIGN and hand-edited blocks — the population cold-boot/board/the cold reviewer read. `brain-graph/1` has NO EMITTER AT ALL (`epic-graph.mjs:12-13` documents a hand-written shape); every graph block is hand-edited, so exposure there is total.

**D3 — the `#452/#478-F2` pin is REWRITTEN, never deleted.**
`parse-verdict.test.mjs:331` becomes the assertion that entries under a space-suffixed key now parse, keeping its comment and id.

## D4 — Governance blast radius (`actor-check`, ADR-0026 Am. 2)

One input class changes: `key:` + whitespace-only, `''` -> `null`. Case analysis over `brain-decision/1`:

| key | today (`''`) | after (`null`) | admission |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocol` | !== PROTOCOL -> refuse | !== PROTOCOL -> refuse | unchanged |
| `decision` | !== 'APPROVE' -> refuse | refuse | unchanged |
| `head_sha` | falsy -> refuse | falsy -> refuse | unchanged |
| `actor` | falsy -> refuse | falsy -> refuse | unchanged |
| `at`, `in_reply_to` | `result.at = ''` | omitted | audit-only, never gates |

NO block becomes admissible that was not, and none stops being admissible — every gate compares against a non-empty literal or tests truthiness, so `''` and `null` are already indistinguishable to all four. `sniffDecisionProtocol` (`actor-check.mjs:229`) is invariant: `''` fails the prefix RE, `null` fails `=== null`; both `continue` silently, neither sets `addressed`. Case analysis, not a green suite.

## Scope

In: `scalar()` regex + contract JSDoc; rewrite the F2 pin; drop stale "not repaired" claims (`parse-verdict.mjs:127-136`, `yaml-block.mjs`); red-first tests per consumer (parse-verdict, decision-block, epic-graph, checkpoint-block, actor-check).
Out: emitter hardening; generic YAML parser; `parseEntryList` extraction; PR #695's locator work.

## Capabilities

New: `yaml-block-scalar` — the shared reader's three-state contract and its blast radius across all FIVE consumers (the ticket said four; `review/lib/checkpoint-block.mjs` is the fifth).
Modified: None.

## Risks

- `findings: ` with nothing under it flips UNREADABLE -> `[]`. Accepted: the answer becomes identical to the byte-equivalent clean `findings:`, which already yields `[]`. Trailing whitespace is insignificant in YAML.
- `epic-graph`: `track: ` moves from group `''` to `'?'`/UNCLASSIFIED (`epic-graph.mjs:73,240`) — can surface a NEW ready-conflict. Correct and conservative; pin it.
- `checkpoint-block` `integerField` error text changes ("got ''" -> "missing the required key"). No test pins either string.
- The "exactly 1 failure in 3394" figure is QUOTED, not re-measured — no shell in the propose phase. `sdd-apply` MUST re-measure.
- PR #695 (issue #639): NOT verified, `gh pr diff` unavailable here. #695 changes WHICH block is located; #612 changes HOW a value is read — orthogonal. Textual conflict risk if #695 adds a locator to `yaml-block.mjs` next to `extractFencedBlock` (51-54), immediately above `scalar` (56-59). Rebase, do not merge blind.

## Rollback

Single-line revert of the `scalar` regex; pin rewrite and new tests revert in the same commit. Pure function, no state, no wire-format change.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `findings: ` with two entries parses to two findings; `malformed` absent.
- [ ] Re-measured suite: only `#452/#478-F2` changes, rewritten not deleted.
- [ ] A test per consumer proves `brain-decision/1` admission is unchanged in BOTH directions.
- [ ] `scalar`'s JSDoc states the contract; no file still claims the defect is unrepaired.

Artifact also at: openspec/changes/issue-612-scalar-trailing-space/proposal.md
